question: Should Discord subagent progress remain a narrowly configured consumer of the existing typed subagent hooks, or should OpenClaw introduce a permanent typed ChannelPlugin progress capability?
rationale: The current patch creates an undeclared channel capability, adds public lifecycle metadata, persists new cleanup state, and exposes seven settings; choosing the permanent owner and compatibility contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Use existing typed hooks
options.body: Keep the behavior Discord-owned and route terminal cleanup through the existing typed subagent lifecycle seam with a smaller public contract.

options.title: Approve typed channel capability
options.body: Define, document, and compatibility-test a first-class ChannelPlugin source-progress capability before adapting this implementation.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Close or defer the PR if the user value does not justify the new configuration and lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Use existing typed hooks
recommendation.body: Keep the behavior Discord-owned and route terminal cleanup through the existing typed subagent lifecycle seam with a smaller public contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-history owner across the affected agent lifecycle, plugin hook, and Discord channel boundaries.
